name: Sherry Cobbler

instructions.primary_message: Combine sherry, sugar and orange slices in a cocktail shaker (if using sugar, stir to dissolve before proceeding). Fill shaker with ice, and shake well. Strain into a highball glass filled with fresh ice. (You may wish to double-strain through a tea strainer if you’re averse to orange pulp in your drink.) Garnish with a slice of orange and fresh blackberries, raspberries or what have you. Poke it with a straw and take it easy.

schema_metadata.keywords: cocktails, sherry, Time for a Drink

description: Let's start the weekend right--with a cocktail recipe from Paul Clarke (The Cocktail Chronicles). Need more than one? Hit up the archives. Cheers! Things usually slow down during late summer. It seems like everyone's on vacation--at least mentally, if not...
notes:
Optional or for serving: Orange slice and fresh berries, for garnish

Optional substitutions: sugar → ¼ oz simple syrup
author: Paul Clarke
